---
title: "callouty-theorem cases"
format:
  html:
    filters:
      - callouty-theorem
  pdf:
    filters:
      - callouty-theorem

callouty-theorem:
  thm: # explicit appearance: outside HTML still a minimal box
    callout:
      type: note
      appearance: default
  lem: # override-title off: outside HTML still a minimal box
    override-title: false
    callout:
      type: note
  def:
    callout:
      type: note
  proof:
    callout:
      type: note
      appearance: default
      collapse: true
---

Used by `check-cases.js` (HTML) and by eye (PDF): no case may show a "Note" bar above a body that prints its own heading.

:::{#thm-explicit}
## Explicit appearance

Every even number above two is not prime.
:::

:::{#lem-no-override}
## Override off

One is not prime.
:::

:::{#def-plain}
## Plain

A prime is a number with two divisors.
:::

:::{.proof}
## Proof (see [@lem-inner])

By [@lem-inner].

:::{#lem-inner}
Inner lemma, nested in the proof body.
:::
:::
